description:
List and summarize insider trades (SEC Form 4) for one company: who bought or sold, when, how much,
their role (CEO, CFO, Director, 10% owner…), and a link to each filing. Use for questions like
'are insiders buying or selling NVDA?' or 'show Tesla insider trades this year'.

open_market_only.description: True = only open-market buys/sells (the meaningful signal). False = include awards, option exercises, gifts, tax withholding.
open_market_only.title: Open Market Only

name: get_insider_activity

data_as_of.description: Latest SEC filing date included in the data (YYYY-MM-DD).
data_as_of.title: Data As Of

disclaimer.default: Public-record data for research and education. Not investment advice. Insider trades can be routine (pre-planned 10b5-1 sales, taxes, diversification); correlation is not causation.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

sources.description: Links to official SEC filings / pages backing the answer.
sources.title: Sources

summary.description: Plain-language answer. Quote this, then cite sources.
summary.title: Summary

title: Insider activity for a company
